name: exercise ball supine triceps extension
description: A dumbbell triceps extension done on an exercise ball, lowering the weight behind your head. Targets the triceps and challenges your balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, then walk forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips level and press the dumbbells straight up, palms facing each other.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms to press them back up.
Keep your hips up for the whole set.
